summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by Marti Technologies, Inc., a foreign private issuer, reporting a Turkish court decision in an unfair competition case brought by driver and trade associations against the company's ride-hailing business. The court partially granted claims but denied all injunctive relief; operations continue uninterrupted. The company will appeal. No M&A, buyback, tender, restructuring, or other special-situation event is involved. This is a purely operational litigation update with no shareholder action required.
